But as all are of the same original stock, a golden parent will sometimes have a silver
son, or a silver parent a golden son. And God proclaims as a first principle to the
rulers, and above all else, that there is nothing which they should so anxiously guard,
or of which they are to be such good guardians as of the purity of the race. They should
observe what elements mingle in their offspring. For if the son of a golden or silver parent
has an admixture of brass and iron, then nature orders a transposition of ranks, and the eye
of the ruler must not be pitiful towards the child, because he has to descend in the scale,
and become a husbandman or artisan, just as there may be sons of artisans who having an
admixture of gold or silver in them are raised to honor, and become guardians or auxiliaries.
For an oracle says that when a man of brass or iron guards the state,
it will be destroyed. Such is the tale. Is there any possibility of making our citizens believe in it?
